comparisons.reason: Item 0 needs an explicit acknowledgment that the OP's initial premise is valid, stated in the comment's own voice and placed before the comment's divergence. Item 1 needs only that a comment directly argues against or engages the OP's main premise at a general level instead of targeting a specific example. These are different constructs. Item 0 is concession-before-disagreement, with an ordering rule. Item 1 is premise-level engagement, with no validity acknowledgment or ordering. Null rules also differ. Item 0 returns null if title and argument are both missing or comments are unparseable. Item 1 returns null if title or argument is missing.
